intended_object: The coproduct of two partially defined (semi)linear maps f : E ⇀ G and g : F ⇀ G: the partial map on E × F with domain dom f × dom g sending (x, y) to f x + g y (from the docstring).
explanation: The domain is f.domain.prod g.domain. The function is the sum of f composed with the first projection and g composed with the second projection, so p in the domain is sent to f p.1 + g p.2, exactly as the docstring says. The extra Module instances on F and G only let f and g both be σ-semilinear into G. The definition is stated for semilinear maps over any rings, which is the natural generality. It is the partial-map analogue of LinearMap.coprod.
